events.text_en: Ngô Thê Đồng watches the young Hùng Phần Vũ stand an hour in the moving fire of Chúc Dung Khẩu, and lends him Xích Thành's banner.
With the banner, Phượng Minh's founder gives Hùng Phần Vũ the body chapters of Xích Thành's canon from the Hall of Spoils, on one condition: that his hall never call itself Xích Thành's heir.
Phượng Minh asks Phần Vũ for a child as surety when its head comes to the Fire Court; Hùng Phần Vũ's daughter, aged twelve, asks to be the one sent, and he lets her go.
Tuân Hà Y of Phần Vũ goes into the mouth of Chúc Dung Khẩu for the Red Wall Rebirth and does not come out.
Phần Vũ's carts haul the stone of Xích Thành's ruined gate to Thạch Cơ Thành for the palace's new jetty.
With its head's court at the Fire Court, Phượng Minh takes the province of Phần Vũ as its seat province; Phần Vũ Đường keeps its hall, its vents and its pits inside it as a vassal holding.
